# Descriptions
@@ 1
The target’s memory of a 20 minute period is blanked. After a period of up to
1 hour (specified by the caster at the time of casting), the target will
remember all that transpired during the period.
@@ 2
Target forgets 10 contiguous minutes totally, caster’s choice.
@@ 3
Target’s mind is temporarily blank and he can do nothing. The target will
remember nothing that occurs during the period. His body stops (all voluntary
actions cease).
@@ 5
As Forget I, except 100 minutes can be erased.
@@ 6
As Mental Block I, except up to 1 hour of memories can be delayed for up to 24
hours.
@@ 7
As Mind Blank I, except duration is 3 rounds.
@@ 9
As Forget I, except 200 minutes can be erased.
@@ 10
Target’s mind is blanked as in Mind Blank I, at random, for 10 contiguous
minutes each and every day.
@@ 11
Target loses 5% of his collected experience (usually experience points).
@@ 12
As Mental Block I, except memories of up to 1 hour/level can be delayed for up
to 1 day per level.
@@ 13
As Mind Blank I, except duration is 5 rounds.
@@ 14
As Forget I, except 1 hour per level of the caster can be erased.
@@ 15
As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out twice per day.
@@ 17
As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out three times per day.
@@ 18
As Mind Blank I, except duration is 10 rounds.
@@ 19
As Lost Experience I, except percentage lost is 10%.
@@ 20
As Mind Death I, except target blanks out five times per day.
@@ 25
As Lost Experience I, except loss is 15%.
@@ 30
As Mind Death I, except target blanks out ten times per day.
@@ 50
As Mind Blank I, except the target has a 5% chance of blanking out each round.
